item.title: Building a Simple SHA-256 Hash Cracker in Python
item.description:
Introduction

As part of my journey in cybersecurity and ethical hacking, I built a simple SHA-256 hash cracking tool using Python. The goal of this project was not to break real systems, but to understand how password hashing works, how attackers misuse weak passwords, and why strong password policies and salting are critical in modern security.
